- Overestimate prices when sentiment is high (especially >0.7) — reduce forecast slightly.
- Underestimate prices when sentiment is low (especially <0.4) — increase forecast modestly.
- Overshoot after sharp price spikes — cap forecast at 1–2% below peak if sentiment remains positive.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above recent 5-day average, adjust downward by 1–3%.
- Lagged overreaction: if forecast is >10% above true outcome 3–5 days prior, reduce by 1–2%.
- Horizon-specific: for 30-day forecasts, avoid extreme highs (>+15% above recent 10-day high) unless sentiment is strongly bullish.
- If sentiment drops sharply (e.g., >0.5 to <0.3) within 3 days, reduce forecast by 1–3% to avoid overcorrection.
